instruction: I want to test the new tab search feature in Chrome. Can you enable the tab search experiment for me?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the tab search experiment (enable-tab-search) in Chrome flags. Uses existing evaluator infrastructure. Same difficulty level as original - single experiment flag change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: reads from Chrome Local State file and extracts enabled_labs_experiments list
Metric comparison logic has a semantic flaw: uses exact list equality instead of subset checking
The instruction asks to 'enable the tab search experiment' which should mean 'ensure enable-tab-search is in the enabled experiments list'
Current metric will FAIL if user has other experiments already enabled or enables additional experiments
Expected value 'enable-tab-search' is semantically correct and matches the actual Chrome experiment flag name
Postconfig is correctly configured: restarts Chrome to persist experiment changes to Local State file
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change metric logic from exact list match to subset checking: 'set(rule['names']).issubset(set(enabled_experiments_names))'
This would verify that enable-tab-search is enabled without failing if other experiments are also enabled
Alternative: Update instruction and expected to be explicit about 'enable ONLY the tab search experiment' if exact match is intended
